headline.text: L3 S3 metal detector failed test cards at start of shift — product buildup on rollers caused malfunction, cleaned and *passed retest* by mid-shift.

summary: One metal detector failure at L3 requiring cleaning and retest. Two active quality issues: L3 ML4 produced 2 barrels of product with missing white cream filling due to operator station error; L1 S4 scrapped soft caramel from overnight shift. Sanitation: multiple cleaning verification gaps at L3 including pistachio allergen residue.

holds.title: Soft caramel from overnight shift
holds.summary: S4 3rd shift operator did not let caramel sit long enough before pushing to Conbar — soft texture caramel held for scrap, waiting for empty barrels from L2.
holds.status: On hold pending scrap barrels — Brandon Hernandez to follow up with team tonight.

holds.title: Product with missing white cream filling
holds.summary: L3 ML4 depositor 2 operator left station off, resulting in molds deposited with no white cream filling — 2 barrels of scrap accumulated, more product in cooling cabinet 3 pending verification.
holds.status: Open — operator marking affected molds, Stefan to assess extent in cooling cabinet 3 on arrival.

food_safety.title: Metal detector failed test-card verification
food_safety.summary: S3 metal detector did not close when test cards passed through at start of 1st shift — product buildup on rollers caused malfunction; production and maintenance cleaned rollers, detector passed retest at 10:35.
food_safety.status: Resolved — detector cleaned, test cards pass correctly, production resumed.

food_safety.title: Wire mesh broke on Truffle Line enrober
food_safety.summary: Truffle Line wire mesh broke at 07:32 — team assessed damage as minor and continued running through 1st shift with plan to replace during 3rd shift reheat; QA and supervisors approved continued operation.
food_safety.status: Open — running under supervision, wire mesh replacement scheduled for 3rd shift reheat.

quality.title: S4 caramel dimensions below spec
quality.summary: All S4 caramel checked measured 14.95–15.44 mm, below required 17.3–17.9 mm spec — machine rejecting product; affected caramel removed, production restarted from combing stage after operator adjustments.
quality.status: Resolved — dimensions corrected after adjustments, production resumed.

quality.title: Double truffle in unsealed pouch
quality.summary: Truffle Line packaging inspection found 1 pouch with double truffle and not sealed in 250-piece box sample — QA flagged to operators to monitor flow wrap for doubles and open product.

quality.title: S1 tray label format incorrect
quality.summary: S1 tray label printed in lowercase instead of uppercase per spec — IMS corrected format, QA approved use of lowercase labels already printed as long as BB date correct; future labels will use all-caps format.
quality.status: Resolved — format corrected for future prints, existing stock approved for use.

quality.title: Cardboard box with pretzels under table
quality.summary: S1 Pre-Op Matrix 9 & 10 found cardboard box containing blue bag of pretzels underneath stainless steel table — product removed and disposed before Pre-Op approval.

sanitation.title: S1 framework cleaning verification gap
sanitation.summary: S1 Level 2 cleaning paperwork missing sanitizer documentation for 2 retest locations (ingredient tank framework EM-S1-1, inclusion hopper framework EM-S1-15) — frameworks are non-product-contact but on retest list.
sanitation.status: Open — Charity planning to swab today, needs confirmation frameworks were cleaned.

sanitation.title: Z-conveyors residue from previous product
sanitation.summary: ML1 light cleaning found significant S'mores cereal residue on blue Z-conveyors despite plastic wrap after previous cleaning — not used for current product; supervisor instructed to rewash and remove residue.
sanitation.status: Open — supervisor cleaning conveyors again to remove residue.

sanitation.title: ML1 metal detector belt and roller dirty
sanitation.summary: ML1 metal detector inspection found dirty roller and belt section with chocolate on it — team leader instructed to clean again before use.

sanitation.title: Pistachio and chocolate in S3 die area
sanitation.summary: S3 upper die area inspection found pistachio and chocolate residue during cleaning verification — recleaning performed and reinspected; also found pistachio pieces on pallets above matrices and floor requiring cleaning.
sanitation.status: Resolved for dies after recleaning — pallet and floor cleaning in progress.

allergen.title: Pistachio residue found during S3 cleaning
allergen.summary: S3 cleaning verification found pistachio pieces in upper die area, on pallets above matrices, and on floor in multiple areas — recleaning performed for dies, pallet and floor cleaning in progress.
allergen.status: Dies recleaned and passed — pallet and floor cleaning ongoing.

opportunities.text: Review S1 Level 2 cleaning checklist to clarify framework cleaning scope — today's retest locations showed no sanitizer documentation.
Add S4 caramel rest-time verification to Conbar push SOP — today's and yesterday's soft caramel both trace to operator not waiting long enough.
Consider adding metal detector roller cleaning to daily startup checklist — today's S3 product buildup caused test-card failure requiring mid-shift intervention.
Review idle-equipment wrap/storage protocol — today's ML1 Z-conveyors held S'mores cereal residue despite plastic wrap after cleaning, requiring rework.
Consider adding depositor station status to ML4 operator handoff checklist — today's dep 2 station left off resulted in 2+ barrels of no-fill scrap.
